passages.title: Job Description: Product Manager, Lantern Series
lines: Job summary: The product manager oversees the Lantern series from design to sales and reports to the director. The scope of the role covers the whole product line, not one product. The product manager also works closely with the office manager and gives tasks to the team assistant.

Main duties: Undertake market research once a year. Lead the collaboration between the design team, the factory in Taoyuan and the sales office in London. Plan the yearly budget and work within its constraints. Maximize sales and profit. Check the monthly sales numbers and share them with the team. Take care of operational problems, such as late shipments. Finalize the yearly objectives with the director.

What we are looking for: Strong leadership and good organizational skills. At least two years with the company. Managerial experience is helpful but not required. Your portfolio of past work will be reviewed at your appraisal.

Salary and advancement: The salary is higher than at the coordinator level, and the new salary starts on January 1. Performance is reviewed once a year, and there are opportunities for further advancement.
Please contact me with any questions.

questions.en: Who does the product manager report to?
Which is NOT a main duty?
What is helpful but not required?
questions.zh: 哪一項是有幫助、但不是必要的？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ms. Reed sent the job description. Read it before Friday.
scene.zh: Reed 小姐把職務說明寄來了，星期五前看完。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: As product manager, you'd oversee the whole Lantern series.
scene.zh: 當產品經理，你要負責整個 Lantern 系列。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So the scope is much bigger than your job now.
scene.zh: 所以工作範圍比你現在大很多。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This role involves a lot more management than I'm used to.
scene.zh: 這個職位要管的事，比我習慣的多很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I know. But you've shown real leadership this year.
scene.zh: 我知道。不過你今年已經展現出真正的領導能力了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And managerial experience isn't required. It just helps.
scene.zh: 而且不一定要有管理經驗，有的話比較好而已。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's a big step, and there's room for more advancement later.
scene.zh: 這是一大步，而且之後還有往上升的機會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Read it tonight, and bring me your questions tomorrow.
scene.zh: 今晚看一下，明天把問題帶來問我。

lines.en: Let's start with your appraisal. Overall, it's more than satisfactory.
lines.zh: 先從你的考核開始。整體來說，不只是合格而已。

lines.en: And the stores' feedback on the Lantern series is very favorable.
lines.zh: 而且店家對 Lantern 系列的回饋很正面。

lines.en: That's great to hear. Are they ordering again?
lines.zh: 聽到這個真好。他們有再下單嗎？

lines.en: Most of them are. For me, that's the best indicator.
lines.zh: 大部分都有。對我來說，這是最好的指標。

lines.en: There was one problem, though. In March, you overlooked a duplicate order.
lines.zh: 不過有一個問題。三月的時候，你漏看了一張重複下的訂單。

lines.en: We got five hundred extra lamps from Brightway and incurred extra storage costs.
lines.zh: 我們從 Brightway 多收到五百盞燈，多付了一筆倉儲費。

lines.en: I know. I called Jack urgently that day and sent a correction.
lines.zh: 我知道。我當天就緊急打給 Jack，也寄了更正。

lines.en: And you went straight to Luis in the warehouse with an apology.
lines.zh: 你也馬上去倉庫跟 Luis 道歉。

lines.en: My biggest mistake taught me to check every order twice.
lines.zh: 我犯過最大的錯，讓我學會每張訂單都要檢查兩次。

lines.en: That shows real determination. And being more cautious is a good thing.
lines.zh: 這看得出你的決心。而且變得更謹慎是好事。

questions.en: What does Mr. Ellis call the best indicator?

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your appraisal is more than satisfactory. The stores like your work, too.

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: player

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. You fixed it fast, and now you're much more cautious with orders.
scene.zh: 很好。你很快就處理好了，現在下單也更謹慎了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So tell me, what are you proudest of?
scene.zh: 那你說說，你最驕傲的是什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm proudest of how the team pulled together this year.
scene.zh: 我最驕傲的是今年整個團隊齊心協力。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's true. Even during the June delay, nobody on the team gave up.
scene.zh: 真的。就連六月延誤的時候，也沒有人放棄。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your salary will go up accordingly. Ms. Reed will send you the details.
scene.zh: 你的薪水也會跟著調高，Reed 小姐會把細節寄給你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We expect excellence, and you have a dynamic team behind you.
scene.zh: 我們期待你做到最好，而且你背後有一個很有活力的團隊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now go and tell Dan the good news. He's been waiting all afternoon!
scene.zh: 現在快去跟 Dan 說這個好消息吧。他已經等了一整個下午了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Come over here, Dan, and congratulate our new product manager!
scene.zh: Dan，過來恭喜我們的新產品經理！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I knew it! Congratulations. That's a big milestone.
scene.zh: 我就知道！恭喜。這是一個大里程碑。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here, this cup is for you. I had it personalized with your new title.
scene.zh: 來，這個杯子送你，上面印了你的新職稱。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And these flowers are from all of us, with our appreciation.
scene.zh: 還有這束花是大家送的，表示我們的感謝。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've learned so much from both of you over the past two years.
scene.zh: 這兩年我從你們兩位身上學到好多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: What a nice compliment. I'm grateful, too. You inspire us.
scene.zh: 這句稱讚真好。我也很感激你，你激勵了我們。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: A new chapter! Someday you'll be running this place!
scene.zh: 新的一章！總有一天這裡會由你來帶！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I can't wait to see what we build together next year.
scene.zh: 我好期待明年我們一起做出什麼成績。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's the spirit! Now, office tradition: the new manager buys coffee.
scene.zh: 就是這個精神！好了，辦公室的傳統：新主管請喝咖啡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mr. Ellis would like to do your review next Thursday morning.
scene.zh: Ellis 先生想在下週四早上幫你做考核面談。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can we push the review back to Friday afternoon?
scene.zh: 面談可以延到星期五下午嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your call with London, right? Friday at two is fine.
scene.zh: 你要和倫敦通電話，對吧？星期五兩點可以。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Have you finished your appraisal yet?
scene.zh: 你的考核表寫好了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is it a good idea to mention a weakness in my appraisal?
scene.zh: 在考核表裡提到自己的缺點，這樣好嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, one small one. And say how you overcame it.
scene.zh: 好啊，提一個小的就好。再寫你是怎麼克服的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now let's practice. You can be Mr. Ellis, Dan.
scene.zh: 現在來練習吧。Dan，你來當 Ellis 先生。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay! So, what was your biggest mistake this year?
scene.zh: 好！那麼，你今年犯過最大的錯是什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: My biggest mistake taught me to check every order twice.
scene.zh: 我犯過最大的錯，讓我學會每張訂單都要檢查兩次。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. And what do you think of the new role?
scene.zh: 很好。那你覺得新職位怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This role involves a lot more management than I'm used to.
scene.zh: 這個職位要管的事，比我習慣的多很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So how will you find time for all of it?
scene.zh: 那你要怎麼擠出時間做這些事？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll have Leo handle the incoming orders from now on.
scene.zh: 之後新進來的訂單，我會讓 Leo 來處理。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Smart. Now, what surprised you most here?
scene.zh: 聰明。那在這裡最讓你意外的是什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What surprised me was how much I enjoy working with clients.
scene.zh: 讓我意外的是，我竟然這麼喜歡跟客戶打交道。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great answer. Okay, the job is yours!
scene.zh: 回答得好。好，這個職位是你的了！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thank you, and I promise I won't let you down.
scene.zh: 謝謝您，我保證不會讓您失望。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Save that for Friday! But really, you're ready.
scene.zh: 這句留到星期五再說吧！不過說真的，你準備好了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've learned so much from both of you over the past two years.
scene.zh: 這兩年我從你們兩位身上學到好多。
